customer_question: What will this registration cost, and what is the overall process from here, including what product materials we'll need to provide?
question_variants: What is the breakdown of the proxy registration and Compliance Folder fees?
What is the step-by-step process after we submit the quote request and confirmation forms?
What documents/materials do we need to provide for the Compliance Folder?
actual_issue: After reviewing the customer's quote request form and proxy registration confirmation form (for a business-transfer registration referencing a prior owner's registration info), the consultant provided a cost breakdown and process outline: proxy registration support fee (referencing 'Multi-Design') of ¥250,000, and Compliance Folder creation fee of ¥150,000. The consultant explained the process: the customer follows the Qualification Fee invoice-and-remittance procedure to send the USD registration fee to SIG; once SIG sends a payment confirmation email, the consultant performs the proxy registration; after registration, in addition to documents obtained during the registration process, the customer must provide product materials (Bluetooth section of the operation manual, product block diagram, product outline drawing of the Bluetooth unit) to compile the Compliance Folder for delivery - reusing the prior owner's (NECPF's) Compliance Folder materials is acceptable if available. The consultant also reiterated the 1-year post-discontinuation retention and SIG audit-presentation requirement (likened to a vehicle inspection certificate), and noted the formal quote would be sent separately by sales (Iida). A follow-up internal message confirms the consultant requested sales (Iida) to issue the formal quote with this ¥250,000 + ¥150,000 breakdown to the customer (Nagase at Paramount Bed).
plain_english_explanation: For a proxy SIG registration (here, a Multi-Design-referenced registration for a business-transfer case), the consulting fee structure has two main components: a proxy registration support fee (¥250,000 in this case, referencing the Multi-Design fee schedule) and a separate Compliance Folder creation fee (¥150,000). The overall process is: (1) customer remits the USD Qualification Fee to SIG per the provided procedure document, (2) once SIG confirms receipt by email, the consultant performs the actual registration, (3) after registration, the consultant compiles the Compliance Folder using both registration-process documents and customer-supplied product materials (operation manual's Bluetooth section, block diagram, and outline drawing of the Bluetooth unit) - and if the customer has the prior owner's (NECPF's) existing Compliance Folder materials, those can be reused instead of creating new ones from scratch. The Compliance Folder must then be retained by the customer for 1 year after the product's sales discontinuation and presented only if SIG requests an audit.
consultant_answer: 見積と今後の流れは次の通りです。・代行登録サポート費(Multi-Design参照) ¥250,000 ・コンプライアンスフォルダ作成費 ¥150,000 ・登録費Invoice取得と送金の手順書にしたがってドル送金手続をお願いします。・御社からドル送金後にSIGから入金連絡メールを受領されたら代行登録を行います。・登録実行後、その過程で取得したドキュメントの他に御社から下記製品資料をご提供いただきコンプライアンスフォルダを作成して納品させていただきます。NECPF社のコンプライアンスフォルダの資料流用でも結構です。取扱説明書(Bluetooth部分)、製品のブロック図、製品の外形図（Bluetoothユニット）。コンプライアンスフォルダは認証規定で製品の販売終了後1年間までの保管とSIGの監査の際に提示義務が規定されていますので保管してください。(自動車の車検証のような存在です。) 正式見積書は営業の飯田から送付させていただきます。 (Here is the quote and the process going forward: proxy registration support fee (Multi-Design reference) ¥250,000; Compliance Folder creation fee ¥150,000. Please remit the USD fee per the invoice/remittance procedure. Once SIG sends payment confirmation, we'll perform the registration. After registration, in addition to documents obtained during the process, please provide: Bluetooth section of the operation manual, product block diagram, and outline drawing of the Bluetooth unit - NECPF's existing Compliance Folder materials can be reused if available. Please retain the Compliance Folder for 1 year after sales discontinuation and present it if SIG requests an audit (like a vehicle inspection certificate). The formal quote will be sent by our sales rep Iida.)
decision_logic: Quote a proxy registration referencing the applicable fee schedule (e.g., Multi-Design) for the registration support fee, plus a separate fixed fee for Compliance Folder creation. Sequence the process as: customer USD remittance per procedure -> SIG payment confirmation -> consultant performs registration -> consultant compiles Compliance Folder from registration-process documents plus customer-supplied materials (or reused prior-owner materials if available) -> deliver Compliance Folder with retention/audit instructions.
final_recommendation: Provide the customer a clear two-line fee breakdown (proxy registration support fee referencing the applicable design-reference fee schedule, plus Compliance Folder creation fee), explain the remittance-confirmation-then-registration sequence, specify the exact Compliance Folder materials needed (operation manual Bluetooth section, block diagram, outline drawing), note that prior-owner materials can be reused if available, and restate retention/audit obligations.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the fee breakdown or required Compliance Folder materials aren't communicated clearly upfront, the customer may be unprepared with documents needed after registration, delaying Compliance Folder delivery, or may be surprised by costs not anticipated in their budgeting for the business-transfer registration.
